//:
Markup-fidelity fixture for the HEADING typography component (svelte typography/Heading.svelte, keen Typography.heading/1). SCOPE = a single flat SEMANTIC element. Core's blessed heading is a BARE

..

tag with NO block class — _base.scss styles the raw `h1..h6` type selectors directly, and snippets/typography.html shows bare `

Heading 1

` (there is NO `pa-heading` class in main.css). So heading is a CLASS-LESS bare element (the `` precedent): the only structural input is the LEVEL (which picks the tag h1..h6) and the text slot. Alignment / colour are the shared `pa-text--*` + `.text-*` utilities applied via the class passthrough on ANY element — they are NOT a heading-specific contract and are modelled by the `text`/`paragraph` fixtures, so they are out of scope here. See code.json / section.json for the class-less + container models.

propsVocabulary.level: heading level 1..6 — selects the semantic tag <h1>..<h6>. Default 2. Structural: changes the TAG, emits no class.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the heading element (class passthrough — e.g. a `pa-text--center` alignment utility; not a core heading feature)

goldenConventions: Structural only. The heading is a BARE <h#> element with no class (styled by the `h1..h6` type selectors in _base.scss). No attribute conventions are added. `level` picks the tag; when no extra class is passed the element carries NO class attribute at all. Slot content is a plain text token so the diff checks tag + nesting, not rich content. Class-token order + whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: There is NO pa-heading block class and NO pa-heading--modifier in main.css — the heading is a bare semantic tag. `level` is structural (selects the TAG, produces no class); `content` is the slot; `extraClass` is a class passthrough. All `produces: null`. The block name `pa-heading` therefore matches nothing in main.css — the 'vacuous scope' note is EXPECTED here (this is the legit class-less case, like inline <code>).

level.note: structural — selects the tag h1..h6, emits no class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: The heading is a bare semantic element with no BEM block/modifier classes, so there are no pa-heading--* classes in main.css for the axis-1 reverse check to claim.

scenarios.name: h2-default
scenarios.note: Level 2 is the default — still a bare <h2> with no class.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — a shared pa-text--* alignment utility rides on the heading element; the heading itself emits no class of its own.
